summary: Operator site + its bookmysites engine (public, no login now): $55 on both pull-through types every date read (Nov 2026-Jun 2027), weekly $330; full hookups 30/50 A; showers/laundry/Wi-Fi/pool. Good Sam Park (directory gs true): $49.50 at 10% off, just under the US$50 gate; no gateway within 40 km. Long-stay tests pass (nightly rate posted on its own engine; RV Life reviews Sept-Oct 2026 are mostly one- to three-night stays). Pin matches Good Sam's (~20 m). Discounts left as the directory's. Note trimmed of hookups/amenities/site facts and the obscure 'no on-property water'.
flags: US$50 GATE (borderline): engine rate $55 on every date read; it passes only as a Good Sam Park at 10% off ($49.50). Campers report paying more: RV Life 2026-09 '$55 USD a night, discount Good Sam' (Motorhome), 2026-10 '$60 ... discount Good Sam' and '$65 ... discount Other' (Georgia National Fair dates). A 2026-09 reviewer adds a '$9.95 booking fee' (per stay, not counted). No gateway within 40 km (nearest Atlanta 154 km). Whether the 10% GS discount really comes off $55 is not shown before checkout.

Long-stay: RV Life 2026-10 review: 'This park is definitely older with long term residents.' Nightly and weekly rates are posted on the operator's own engine and most dated reviews are 1-3 night stopovers, so tests 2 and 4 pass; monthly is not sold online.

The park-policies page gives an after-hours number 828-349-0412 and names 'The Great Outdoors RV Resort' (a sister park in Franklin NC) - template text copied from the sister site; the park's own number is 478-987-3141 (stored, correct).
Booking engine is bookmysites (cross.bookmysites.com); the README says bookmysites links had become login pages, but this one shows rates and availability publicly as of 2026-10-29.
